@realm:     Mentalism

@category:  Base
@class:     Seer

# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Watersight | caster | 10min/lvl | self | U
 2 | Nightsight | caster | 10min/lvl | self | U
 3 | Fogsight | caster | 10min/lvl | self | U
 4 | Woodsight II | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
 5 | Long Ear | caster | C | 10'/lvl | U
 6 | Observe I | caster | C | 10' | U
 7 | Long Eye | caster | C | 10'/lvl | U
 8 | Invisiblesight | caster | 10min/lvl | self | U
 9 | Stonesight II | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U

15 | Utterdarksight | caster | 10min/lvl | self | U

18 | Wallsight | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
19 | Waiting Observe | caster | 1 day/lvl | self | U
20 | Greater Long Sense | caster | C | 1 mi/lvl | U

30 | Sight True | caster | 1 min/lvl (C) | self | U
50 | Long Sense True | caster | C | unlimited | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster can see through 10' per level of water (even murky water) as if it were
day. Some residual light must exist for this spell to work.
@@ 2
As Watersight, except caster can see in normal darkness such as a clear night
outdoors. Some residual light (e.g., starlight, phosphorescent fungus) must
exist for this spell to work.
@@ 3
As Watersight, except caster can see in fog, mist, any other precipitation or
any gas.
@@ 4
Caster can see through non-magical wood (up to 1'' thickness per level of
experience).
@@ 5
Caster’s point of hearing may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level
of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. He must physically be able to go
there (e.g., he could not send his hearing through walls or closed doors).
@@ 6
Caster can pick a point (up to 10' away), and he will be able to see and/or
hear from that point. The point is fixed but can be rotated. There can be
intervening barriers such as walls.
@@ 7
Caster’s point of sight may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level
of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. The point of sight may also be
rotated. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his
sight through walls or closed doors).
@@ 8
Caster can see all invisible beings or objects as if they were not invisible.
Note that this means the invisible object is not “detected;” it simply isn’t
invisible to the caster.
@@ 9
As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical stone.
@@ 10
As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical iron or steel.
@@ 11
Caster can see “through” all visual illusions, phantasms, and glamours.
@@ 12
As Observe I, except for the range.
@@ 13
As Long Ear, except for the range and the caster may move any and all senses.
@@ 14
As Ironsight II, except caster may see through any non-magical metal.
@@ 15
As Nightsight, except caster can see through magically created darkness (such
as those resulting from Dark or Utterdark spells) or total ordinary darkness
(i.e., no residual light required).
@@ 16
As Observe I, except 2 points up to 100' away may be observed simultaneously.
@@ 17
As Observe I, except for the range.
@@ 18
As Woodsight, except caster can see through any non-magical wall of any
thickness.
@@ 19
As Observe III, except caster does not have to concentrate until the spell is
triggered by some movement or some sound which could be perceived from the
observation point (and after the spell “activates,” the caster must
concentrate on the point or the spell will be dispelled). If the caster is
ever more than 100' per level of experience of the point selected, the spell
is dispelled.
@@ 20
As Long Sense, except for the range.
@@ 25
As Observe III, except for the duration and the caster need not concentrate
(he need only glance and listen once every three rounds).
@@ 30
As Woodsight II, except the caster can see through all inanimate material.
Highly magical materials might receive an RR (at the GM’s discretion).
@@ 50
As Long Sense, except the caster may move his senses with no limitations on
range.
